name: Veklom
description: Consequence boundary for AI agents. An agent can hold the code, the state and old credentials and still not be allowed to cause the next real effect: every consequential action needs a current, scoped grant from CAPPO, its result is read back from the target, and evidence is kept in a separate ledger.

bearer.description: Veklom session token, machine token, or mount-holder credential. Obtain via https://veklom.com/signup.

skills.name: mount
skills.description: Request a bounded, expiring capability mount (credential required).

skills.name: execute
skills.description: Request one governed action; CAPPO decides; at most once per operation_id (credential required).

skills.name: readback
skills.description: Read the target's own state (credential required).
